text: बच्चों की छुट्टियाँ 20 मई से शुरू होंगी और स्कूल 1 जुलाई को फिर खुलेगा।
reference: The children's holidays will start on 20 May and school will reopen on 1 July.

text: Aaj dinner mein kya banau? Fridge mein sirf paneer aur shimla mirch hai.
reference: What should I make for dinner today? There's only paneer and capsicum in the fridge.
